name: Nakashibetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nakashibetsu town emblem in white: a broken ring of concentric segments enclosing the character 中.
history: Municipal flag of Nakashibetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1950.

features.role: Nakashibetsu town emblem — a broken ring of concentric segments enclosing the character 中
